intro: Skin Essence's Pune clinic is on the 21st floor of Tower T9, Brahma Business Park, near F Residence in New Kalyani Nagar. It is a short drive from Koregaon Park, Viman Nagar, Kharadi, Yerwada, Wadgaon Sheri, Camp and Mundhwa.
Dr. Daksha Patel, MBBS, MD (Skin & VD), consults here for medical dermatology, cosmetic procedures, laser treatments, hair and scalp care and paediatric skin problems, for women and men.
